categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Wandekai Fluid Equipment Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, development, production, and sales of copper plumbing valves and fittings. Its product portfolio includes various types of valves such as ball valves, angle valves, stop valves, gate valves, butterfly valves, and pipe fittings used in water supply, heating, and drainage systems. The company serves both export markets, mainly the US and Europe, and domestic markets with a focus on HVAC components and household appliances.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered advanced lead-free copper processing technologies, enabling efficient mass production of environmentally friendly plumbing products. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including cold and hot forming, precision machining, and surface treatments like electroplating and pickling. The firm integrates industrial internet technologies for automation, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing, enhancing product quality and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known plumbing equipment manufacturers and brand distributors primarily in the US, Europe, South America, Australia, and Southeast Asia. Major clients include RWC, Watts, Oatey, Sioux Chief, Mosack, and Home Depot. The company targets mid-to-high-end market segments with a focus on environmentally friendly, lead-free plumbing products. Domestic sales focus on HVAC and refrigeration components, distributed mainly through dealers serving end consumers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Zhejiang Province, China, with manufacturing facilities and headquarters in Yuhuan City. It has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Vietnam (Jinhong Copper Industries) to leverage regional advantages. Its sales are predominantly export-oriented, focusing on North America and Europe, while also expanding in South America, Australia, and Southeast Asia. Domestic sales are growing, supported by subsidiaries and affiliated companies in Zhejiang.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Wandekai operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing core plumbing valves and fittings from raw materials like copper rods. It procures raw materials and components, processes them into finished products, and supplies them to downstream manufacturers and distributors. The company controls key production processes but outsources some parts and surface treatments.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in lead-free copper technology, intelligent and integrated valve systems, and product diversification into iron and stainless steel valves. It invests in developing high-performance, durable, and easy-to-maintain valves such as impact-resistant washing machine angle valves, safety water hammer valves, and quick-connect pipe valves. Collaborations with universities focus on new materials, processing innovations, and digital integration of valve systems. The firm aims to enhance product quality, expand industrial applications, and strengthen its technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of plumbing valves and fittings, with a dominant share from export sales under ODM and OEM arrangements. Pricing is cost-plus with adjustments based on raw material prices and exchange rates. Domestic sales are mainly through distributors under the company’s own brand. The company also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading mid-to-high-end plumbing valve manufacturer with strong technological capabilities in lead-free copper products. It competes internationally with major global valve manufacturers serving the US and European markets. Its certifications (NSF, CUPC, UL, CSA) and long-term relationships with top clients provide competitive advantages. The domestic market is fragmented with many low-end competitors, but the company focuses on quality and innovation to maintain a strong position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 996 million, a 44.56% increase over the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 150 million, up 44.52%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.83 billion, growing 9.3% year-over-year. Operating cash flow improved significantly by 131.92%. The firm has shown steady growth driven by expanding export orders and domestic market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced lead-free copper manufacturing technology, ensuring environmentally friendly and health-safe plumbing products. It offers high-quality, durable valves with certifications required for the stringent North American market. Its product innovation focuses on intelligent, integrated valve systems and user-friendly designs that improve reliability and ease of maintenance. The firm leverages its industrial cluster location and supply chain integration to maintain cost efficiency and product consistency.
